method: 48 local Jacobi neighbor averages at factor 0.5 across connected native underarm cloth. Graded rest-space mask and attachment protection; per-control total bone influence retained. Original control geometry, UVs, old keys, body weights, bones and action remain intact.

upper_torso_ease.method: Graded torso-quarter selection in the upper chest/back. One editable rest fit reduces excessive ease by at most 12 mm, retaining at least the proposed 22 mm rest stand-off before later deformation/modifiers. This is not an animated clearance certificate.

underarm_fold_bend.scope: Graded paired front/rear torso UV regions around the diagnosed residual fold; attachment protection and retained body constraint.
